comment: World (ii) of the families round, matter and gravity (HIGHLIGHTS.md, Every family run on the engine and seen to work; the advisor's blinds, #1563 comment 5928483084; ALGEBRA.md, The lattice constants, The two rows, rows (a) and (i)): the massless row's rest about one body, read in levels along the axes from the body's centre. One compact pixel of the matter family, `quanta` quanta in the engine's count at the centre of the open box of `shape`, laid by the generator; the universe `gravity_at_ten.json`, the rule's own rows (examples/events/rule.json) with gravity's level weight at `level_weight` in place of the law's LW = 1,000, so that the row's rest stands in levels: at the law's weight the row writes under two levels at the Node and nothing beyond one Link (ALGEBRA.md row (i): under one level in the looks at LW = 10^3), and the same body at the law's weight is examples/events/matter_alone/pixel.json, whose reading of gravity's row is this world's blind at the law's weight. The source s is the body's well in quanta per interval over the row's level weight (the one write per interval, (SUM D + r) div (E_s T)), read from the lay before any run (tools/body_rest.py reads the well at the start; on main 3fe40aeb's engine the lay gave the pixel's clock pair [12532, 8095] against [12789, 8310] at the law's weight, the row's rest at the start 201, 71, 33, 20, 13, 10 levels at 0 to 5 Links along an axis and the binding holder's 1,997, 699, 327, 192, 128, 91; the world is laid anew on the finished engine, whose rest differs, and no world laid on the old engine is committed). No fall world: at LW = 1,000 nothing falls by gravity within the binding holder's range (row (i)), at the weight 10 the pull of a second body of the window is still the binding holder's within R = 20, and a readable fall by gravity alone needs the weight 1 of the looks before The two rows, which the law left (the fall look of row (x) is the tube's); the fall's line stands in the blind as the law states it. Headless, `ticks` intervals, the reading at the window's ends, a GameBoard reading and no click. The run is not performed in the round that prepares it.
reading: per world (tools/body_rest.py, GameBoard): the gravity row's level at the Nodes r = 0 through 6 along each axis from the body's centre at the window's ends (the rest at the start, the start's own iteration, and after the run), the body's well over the board in quanta (its source), the body's 2 cos omega_b at its centre against the same body's at the law's weight (examples/events/matter_alone/pixel.json), the binding holder's level along the same axes beside it, and the books.

blind.static_rest: the row's rest about a static source of s quanta per interval at the level weight E_s is 3 G(r) s / E_s with the six Ports' Green's function on an open box: 3 G(0) = 0.7582 at the Node, 0.2582, 0.1286, 0.0826, 0.0608 and 0.0483 at 1 to 5 Links, 3 / (4 pi r) = 0.2387 / r far (r x level 0.258, 0.257, 0.248, 0.243, 0.242); on the box of 61 the levels read 0.0067 s lower and on the box of 41 0.0099 s lower by the faces' images, on this box of 25 lower still, the faces reading 0 (the number not given: the box's own, read against the formula); the integer levels round the formula's number, the start's iteration at a fine unit
blind.source: s = the body's well per interval, SUM over its Nodes of D_i div T, over the level weight: the well 0.712 of the count at 2,000 in the advisor's unit (row (u)), the lay's own well read before the run by tools/body_rest.py; at the law's weight 1,000 the same s gives under two levels at the Node and 0 beyond one Link
blind.tensions: the row's three axis lines at rest about the body, each Node its own part -num h_a(i), the Link's tension the mean of its two ends (ALGEBRA.md, The tension; the first look's row (s): the axis parts at rest +262 at the Node at 2,000 under every level weight 1, over the level weight here)
blind.clock: two bound bodies at one Node shift their rest rotations alike: 1 - cos omega_b = (p_0 / Gamma)^2 (1 - cos omega_0) at the body's content, the redshift f(omega_0) U with f = 2 (1 - cos omega_0) / (omega_0 sin omega_0), 1.06 at [2, 3], U = c / Gamma the level the body reads; here the body's own gravity level at the weight 10 against the law's weight shifts its 2 cos omega_b by about f U of its binding margin, a reading beside the blind (row (a))
blind.fall: the law's line, not read in this world: the tent Delta^2 a = -3 sigma at the heavy body's Nodes, linear outside with the slope half the body's total source; the light body's acceleration a = Delta |d omega_b / d c| |c_+ - c_-| / D toward the heavy body with Delta d omega_b / dc = (2 / (3 Gamma)) cos omega_0 / (1 + cos omega_0) (0.4 of 2 / (3 Gamma) at [2, 3]), the fall of L Links in t = sqrt(2 L / a) intervals; a compact pixel falls by its tail alone, 0.27 of a free packet's at c / Gamma = 0.167, 0.11 at 0.25, 0.03 at 0.375 and none at the horizon; a cloud as a free quantum to (C / Gamma)^2
